english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something has been distorted or its intended meaning has been altered.

examples.english: They twisted my meaning; I only wanted everyone to calm down.
examples.traditional: 你唔好扭曲我嘅意思，我只係想大家冷靜啲。

english.note: Use this for a face or body that is physically contorted or turned out of shape.

examples.english: Their face was wry with pain.
